source: 2-loop Tradition-with-cut benchmark.  Family taken from upstream AMFlow examples/automatic_phasespace/run.wl: 7 propagators, cut={1,0,1,0,1,0,0}, prescription={0,0}, kinematics s=100, msq=1.  The cut topology is *not* phase_volume (var size 7 > loopnum+1 = 3), so Cutkosky scheme does not apply and AMFlow falls through to Tradition with eta injection at an uncut propagator.  Running the boundary integrand reduction then exercises the parent-cut projection in `AMFSystem::build_boundary` (Phase 1B fix, mirror of AMFlow.m:790-803).  This is the first oracle that actually exercises the Tradition-with-cut code path; previously the C++ port aborted in detect-and-throw mode.
